title: List Restore Request
description: Previews (dry_run) or performs the restore of an earlier version of a record shown in a list. A restore is a new revision: it never rewinds the history. Without dry_run, expected_version is required.

page_id.description: The page the list is on.

expected_version.description: The current version the person saw. A restore based on an older version is refused with 409.

field_keys.description: Restore only these fields (the way to resolve a blocked restore). Omit to restore every field that differs.

dry_run.description: Only report what the restore would change and what blocks it; write nothing.

preview.description: Act on the draft of the page instead of its published version. Only for a signed-in person who may read the draft; it must match what the person is looking at (the page endpoint's `preview`). Without it the published version is used. The page access rights, the live data and the permissions stay the same.
